resolutions.researcher_notes: The current_ref was a /save/ trigger URL for www.163.com (dead as a direct citation format); www.163.com itself now returns 403 to direct fetch, but the archive.org 'available' API confirms a live snapshot (captured fresh today, 2026-07-29). Verified via url_verifier with tokens '北海LNG' + '贵港' present. This 2023-10-27 人民资讯 wire piece on a Guangxi/Sichuan gas resource conference explicitly lists '广西LNG外输管道复线（北海LNG-贵港）' among trunk pipelines still at the '规划建设' (planned/to-be-built) stage under the 14th Five-Year Plan (grouped with two sibling trunk projects, ~1250km/~15bn yuan combined) — directly supports Status=proposed. Cross-check caveat: a separate China Electric Power Bidding Network (dlzb.com) tender-tracking listing for this same named project, archived 2023-09-25 (used below for Length/Location/Owner/Operator), shows an inconsistent internal state — its header metadata field says '进展阶段 施工中' (construction) but its own project-overview body text says '进展阶段:环境影响评价' (EIA stage, i.e. still pre-construction) with a stated 2023-2024 build window. Given that self-contradiction and that it is a commercial project-tracking aggregator (not a primary government notice) I did not treat it as a clean corroborating source for Status specifically — only the unambiguous 163.com wire story is cited here, consistent with the prior deep-sweep audit's own medium-tier call on this same source.

Found via web.archive.org/wayback/available (the live dlzb.com page and its /save/ trigger both previously timed out for the deep-sweep auditor; the 2023-09-25 snapshot loads fine now). China Electric Power Bidding Network (中国电力招标网) project-tracking listing titled '广西LNG外输管道复线(北海LNG-贵港)项目' states verbatim: '本项目线路全长约244km' — an exact match to the recorded 244.00 km. Single source (extensive prior + fresh Chinese-language search, incl. gas.in-en.com and provincial DRC approval indices, found no second independent source stating this segment's length specifically), so tier=medium per the confidence-tier rule.

No source states a diameter for this segment. Re-checked the dlzb.com tender listing found for Length/Location/Owner (full text captured and searched for 'mm', '管径', 'DN', '口径' — none present; it lists equipment/materials generically but no pipe diameter). Re-searched gas.in-en.com, NDRC/Guangxi DRC approval-notice patterns, and EIA-document hosts (sthjt.gxzf.gov.cn, eia.mee.gov.cn — both unreachable, DNS-level, consistent with the brief's known-blocked-host pattern but no wayback snapshot found via the availability API for either as a general domain check). Web-search tool was unavailable (session budget exhausted) and search-engine scraping via curl (Baidu, Bing, DuckDuckGo) returned only captchas/empty shells. Leaving unresolved rather than fabricating or reusing an unrelated diameter figure — consistent with the deep-sweep auditor's own prior finding.

Same dlzb.com listing: '项目位于北海市铁山港区已建北海LNG接收站内改扩建铁山港首站' — the pipeline originates inside the existing Beihai LNG receiving terminal at Tieshangang, renovating/expanding the Tieshangang First Station. This is the same LNG receiving facility this whole wiki page's row-cluster is fed by (referred to elsewhere in the page's own citation trail as '广西液化天然气（LNG）项目' / Guangxi LNG project at Beihai) — i.e. the recorded FuelSource='Guangxi LNG Terminal' is this facility under its province-level name. Single source; tier=medium.

Exact match on both endpoints in the same dlzb.com listing: start = '北海市铁山港区已建北海LNG接收站内改扩建铁山港首站' (Tieshangang First Station, Tieshangang District, Beihai — matches StartLocation/StartPrefecture exactly); end = '线路终点位于贵港市港北区根竹镇根竹村已建贵港压气站内' (Guigang Compression Station, Genzhu Village, Genzhu Town, Gangbei District, Guigang — matches EndLocation/EndPrefecture exactly, including the village/town names GEM records but no other source I found even mentioned). Verified tokens '根竹镇' and '铁山港' both present via url_verifier. Single source; tier=medium given the specificity/exactness of the match but only one corroborating document found.

dlzb.com listing states '业主单位 国家管网集团西南管道有限责任公司' (project owner unit: National Pipe Network Group Southwest Pipeline Co., Ltd.) — an exact character match to the recorded QCCOwner(业主单位) value. Chinese '业主单位' denotes the commissioning/owning entity; I'm citing it for Operator too because in PipeChina's centralized system this same subsidiary both owns and operates the segments it commissions (no other operating entity appears anywhere in this row-cluster's citation trail), matching the prior deep-sweep audit's own reasoning for this field. Single source; tier=medium.
Same '业主单位 国家管网集团西南管道有限责任公司' line directly supports Owner1='National Pipe Network Group Southwest Pipeline Co Ltd' at 100%. Single source; tier=medium.
